description: PAID $0.003 USDC. Live equity/index/commodity perps on Hyperliquid HIP-3 builder DEXes (tradeXYZ xyz + peers): mark/oracle, 24h change, funding, open interest, 24h volume, large recent taker prints and whale net by symbol. Timed to CFTC Nov 2026 US stock-perp clearance. Params symbol, dex, limit, min_usd. Covered by pass_day/pass_month. No charge on failure. Returns JSON for the matching HIP-3 equity perps: mark, oracle, 24h change, funding, open interest, 24h volume, large taker prints, and whale net by symbol.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

dex.description: Optional HIP-3 builder DEX slug. Format: a short lowercase slug. The tool text already lists xyz, flx, cash, km, mkts, io, para, and vntl. Example: xyz. Omit for every builder DEX.

limit.description: Maximum number of markets in the response. Format: positive integer. Example: 20. Omit for the server's current cap.

min_usd.description: Minimum notional in USD for the large-trade list. Format: number of US dollars. Example: 1000. Default: 1000, as the existing tool text states.

symbol.description: Optional comma-separated equity tickers. Format: uppercase tickers separated by commas, no spaces required. Example: TSLA,NVDA. Omit for the full equity book.
